lede: Every Higgsfield plan for AI video and images, how many credits each one gives you, and the cheapest plan for what you generate each month.
calc_label: Higgsfield credits you need each month
calc_note: The calculator uses the Individual plans on Higgsfield's pricing page, with Ultra at 3,000, 6,000 or 9,000 credits a month. Each model uses its own number of credits: for example Seedance 2.5 at 720p uses 35 credits per 5 seconds of video and Nano Banana Pro 2 credits per image. Subscription credits do not roll over. Unlimited models and free generations are not counted, since they only work on higgsfield.ai.

after_plans: Yearly prices are the ones on Higgsfield's pricing page on 15 November 2026, during its Black Friday offer (up to 60% off yearly plans); the page does not show what yearly billing costs after the offer. On monthly billing the first month of Plus is $47 and of Ultra $79 (3,000 credits), $150 (6,000) or $209 (9,000), then the regular prices in the table. Ultra on the card is for 3,000 credits a month. Prices exclude VAT and local taxes. Business plans for teams are priced per seat: Team from $79 and Scale from $215 per seat a month, with Enterprise on request.

faq: Free is $0 with no monthly credits. Starter is $19/month for 270 credits. Plus is $59/month for 1,200 credits and Ultra is $129/month for 3,000 credits, going up to $375/month for 9,000. During the Black Friday offer, yearly billing is $35/month for Plus and from $65/month for Ultra.

Each model uses a set number of credits per generation, depending on the model, the length and the resolution. For example Seedance 2.5 at 720p uses 35 credits per 5 seconds of video, and Nano Banana Pro uses 2 credits per image. Subscription credits do not roll over and expire at the end of each credit cycle.
Yes. The Free plan gives limited access to selected AI models, no monthly credits and one generation at a time. Commercial use is not included on Free.
